spec_tool_gitignore_proxy_upper_bound.note: filename:.gitignore matching the marker string — an OVER-estimate (matches comments/negations/.gitignore.* variants); true excludes are rarer. commit:gitignore ratio is ~100:1 to 1000:1 in favor of committing.

content_linting_tools._note: added 2026-06-27 — de-facto tool adoption for content/prose linting in CI (grounds the de-jargon gate approach)
content_linting_tools.reading: markdownlint = most-adopted (structural MD); Vale = de-facto for prose + forbidden-terms (reject.txt); cspell moderate. For a single-purpose jargon-block, a custom grep CI job is the documented minimal-viable.
